criteria.name: Identity and GIS footprint fidelity
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS layer 0 OBJECTID 615 identifies STEW / Stewart Center. The 52 wall segments follow the cleaned 53-vertex GIS boundary; the reported local wall bounds track transformed GIS bounds to under 0.01 m, and the footprint overlay shows the stepped perimeter.
criteria.limitations: The campus GIS polygon is a mapping footprint, not a measured facade survey. It verifies plan outline only, not wall offsets or architectural articulation.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, scale, and interior layout
criteria.evidence: Fresh reopen confirms AssetRoot_stewart_center at identity and origin. The manifest records the established origin [91.0499983, -253.375] m. All three retained module bounding boxes fall within the GIS polygon. The 2024 Road School maps support a south/main entrance and Loeb east/northeast of the central library.
criteria.limitations: The Road School plan has neither north arrow nor scale. Ringel appears west/left of central HSSE on the schematic, while its modeled bounds are centered east of HSSE; module coordinates therefore remain approximate. The current master instance marker was not freshly reopened in this asset-only pass.

criteria.name: Floors, height, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue archival source supports three floors in the central portion. The asset has walls to 16.5 m and total bounds to 22.5 m, with a flat GIS-bounded roof polygon.
criteria.limitations: Wall and overall heights, roof elevation, and rooftop plant forms are explicitly estimates; no dimensioned elevation or roof plan supports them. The broad flat roof and block-like rooftop forms remain visually generic.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive identity
criteria.evidence: Fresh south/north oblique renders show perimeter-following brick walls, window rhythm, horizontal base courses, a framed south entrance, glazing, and broad steps. These provide a recognizable massing and entrance treatment.
criteria.limitations: The repeated windows and brick facade still read generically. The available Purdue reference shows a more specific stone-framed/columned entry. The incorporated historic library and reconstructed Fowler Hall are not clearly legible as distinct volumes; the documented mural is not modeled. Roof/context forms also lack clear source support.

criteria.name: Modular integrity, portability, and evidence quality
criteria.evidence: Blender freshly reopened the exact asset SHA and found 1,940 objects (1,927 meshes), an identity root, zero materialless meshes, and zero missing image dependencies. Build/validation records, GIS snapshot, footprint overlay, floor-map snapshots, and three views are present.
criteria.limitations: Evidence remains weaker for facade dimensions, exact interior offsets, roof, and heights; the master link was not inspected in this independent asset grade.
